body.purpose: Article and paragraph copy, 65-75ch max width.

label.purpose: Form labels and small UI copy.

shadows.name: ambient-icon-glow
shadows.purpose: Soft glow under icon-button SVGs, swaps to accent color on hover.

shadows.name: outline-hover-glow
shadows.purpose: One-off hover accent on outline buttons, paired with a blur+hue-rotate backdrop-filter.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Input focus ring, paired with an accent-colored border and outline.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default 0.2s transition for buttons and general state changes.

motion.name: ease-card-hover
motion.purpose: 0.3s post-card hover transition (title color, arrow reveal).

motion.name: ease-modal-enter
motion.purpose: 0.4s 3D slide-in-from-top entrance for the native dialog modal.

motion.name: ease-checkbox-spring
motion.purpose: Checked-state transform on custom checkbox/switch inputs; the system's one spring-like easing.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background-color: #e88923; color: #eeeeee; border: none; border-radius: 3px; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s ease-in-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background-color: #d97d1a; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e88923; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Transparent button with accent border, glowing hover state.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background-color: transparent; color: #eeeeee; border: 1px solid #e88923; border-radius: 3px; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s ease-in-out; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { box-shadow: 0 0 15px 1px rgba(255,180,51,0.5); backdrop-filter: blur(3px) hue-rotate(21deg); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e88923; }

components.name: Post Card
components.description: Translucent tinted card for a blog post preview, with reveal-on-hover arrow.

components.css: .ds-post-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1.2rem; padding: 2rem; background-color: rgba(36,180,233,0.08); border-radius: 3px; text-decoration: none; color: inherit; position: relative; } .ds-post-card__title { margin: 0; font-family: 'Source Sans Pro', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.5rem; transition: color 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.65,0.05,0.36,1); } .ds-post-card__excerpt { margin: 0; font-size: 1.1rem; line-height: 1.6; } .ds-post-card__read-more { font-size: 1.2rem; font-weight: 700; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.25rem; margin-top: auto; } .ds-post-card__arrow { opacity: 0; transition: all 0.2s ease-in-out; } .ds-post-card:hover .ds-post-card__title { color: #ed3c63; } .ds-post-card:hover .ds-post-card__arrow { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(0.15rem); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Bordered text field with a soft accent focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { font-size: 1rem; background-color: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #384263; border-radius: 3px; padding: 0.55rem; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px transparent; transition: border-color 200ms, box-shadow 200ms; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #e88923; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(255,180,51,0.3); outline: 1px solid #e88923; }

components.name: Modal
components.description: Native dialog with blurred backdrop and a 3D fly-in entrance.
components.css: .ds-modal { border-radius: 3px; border: none; background-color: #eeeeee; padding: 2rem; animation: ds-modal-in 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.25,0.46,0.45,0.94) both; } .ds-modal::backdrop { background-color: rgba(0,0,0,0.3); backdrop-filter: blur(4px); } @keyframes ds-modal-in { 0% { transform: translateZ(-1400px) translateY(-800px); opacity: 0; } 100% { transform: translateZ(0) translateY(0); opacity: 1; } }

narrative.overview: The blog reads as a printed halftone sheet lit from behind by a sunset. Every page sits on a fine dot-grid texture (a tiled SVG halftone pattern, not a flat color), with two soft diagonal gradient glows — warm amber-to-coral in light mode, navy-to-coral in dark mode — washing across the top and bottom of the viewport behind the content. The UI itself stays deliberately quiet and near-flat (3px corners, thin borders, translucent tints) so the textured background and the accent color do the visual work, not the chrome. The system explicitly rejects glossy card-heavy SaaS staging: no drop shadows stacked for hierarchy, no rounded-pill everything, no neutral-gray flatness. Depth and mood come from texture and color wash, not elevation.
keyCharacteristics: Halftone dot-grid background texture on every page, both themes.
Diagonal warm-gradient glow blobs behind main content, theme-aware.
Near-flat geometry: a single 3px radius used everywhere, never fully rounded.
One accent color per theme: amber/gold in light mode, coral-red in dark mode.
Single sans-serif family (Source Sans Pro) carries the entire type system.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Only one hot accent color is live at a time — amber in light mode, coral in dark mode. They never appear together on the same render; the .dark class swap on <html> is the single source of truth for which one is active.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: No second typeface is introduced for contrast; every weight and size step comes from Source Sans Pro's own range.

rules.name: The No-Stack Rule
rules.body: Never stack multiple box-shadows to fake elevation tiers (card < modal < tooltip). If something needs to feel above the page, use blur/tint or motion, not a heavier shadow.

dos: Do keep the halftone dot-grid background and diagonal gradient glows on every page — they are the system's signature, not decoration to be dropped on busy pages.
Do use exactly one accent color at a time (amber in light mode, coral in dark mode), driven only by the .dark class on <html>.
Do use the 3px radius (base.$border-radius) on every rounded surface — buttons, inputs, cards, modal, nav shell. Never introduce a second radius scale.
Do convey depth through translucent tint + blur (backdrop-filter) or through motion (the modal's 3D entrance), not through stacked box-shadows.
Do respect the motion / no-motion feature toggle already wired through sass-butler's feature() mixin — every hover/transition effect must have a static fallback for prefers-reduced-motion.
donts: Don't stack multiple box-shadows to simulate elevation tiers (card < modal < tooltip); this system does not have an elevation ladder.
Don't introduce a second typeface for "contrast" — hierarchy comes from weight and size within Source Sans Pro only.
Don't use pure #fff as a large-surface background; the system's near-white is Paper (#eeeeee).
Don't show both accent colors (amber and coral) at once on the same render — only one is ever "live," matching the current theme.
Don't round corners beyond 3px, and don't leave any interactive surface (button, input, card) with square corners either — the 3px radius is a fixed, uniform choice, not a per-component decision.
